Enum EventType

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<EventType>
com.github.jamesnetherton.zulip.client.api.event.EventType
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<EventType>
public enum EventType extends Enum<EventType>
Defines the Zulip event types. Event types that have a dedicated Event implementation are mapped to it. All other event types are mapped to Event, with the event payload available from Event.getProperties().
See Also:
  • https://zulip.com/api/get-events#events-by-type
